entities.name: P45512 glycerol regulator
observations: Exact 641-aa sequence match to reviewed Citrobacter freundii P45512; annotated as transcriptional activator of the glycerol-utilization dha operon.
Related E. coli K-12 homolog P76016 (72.4% identity, 98.3% query coverage) positively regulates dhaKLM and represses its own expression.
Predicted domains: GAF, PAS, sigma-54 activator, AAA lid, and HTH DNA-binding domains.

entities.name: Glycerol utilization dha operon
observations: The exact-sequence reference annotation identifies this protein as a transcriptional activator of the glycerol-utilization dha operon.

entities.name: DNA-templated transcription regulation
observations: GO annotations for the exact-sequence reference include regulation of DNA-templated transcription; E. coli homolog evidence additionally supports positive regulation.
